title: SMOK Novo GT Box Pod Vape Kit
description: The Smok Novo GT Box Pod Kit is the perfect fusion of performance and style, offering a compact and user-friendly pod system with a host of premium features. Powered by a built-in 1700mAh battery, the Novo GT Box delivers up to 30W of adjustable power, ensuring you have all-day battery life and plenty of control over your vaping experience. Designed for flexibility, the Novo GT Box Kit is compatible with Smok’s Novo series of pods, including 0.6Ω and 0.8Ω mesh coils. These coils are optimized for rich flavour and satisfying vapour production, making the kit suitable for both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vaping styles. The 2ml refillable pod is TPD-compliant and features a top-filling system for hassle-free refills. The kit’s adjustable airflow system allows you to fine-tune your draw, while the 2.01-inch full-colour screen provides real-time vaping data such as wattage, puff count, and battery life, ensuring you’re always in control of your vape. With USB Type-C fast charging, the 1700mAh battery recharges quickly, meaning less downtime and more time vaping. The Novo GT Box also offers inhale activation, so you can simply draw on the mouthpiece to activate the device. Crafted with durability in mind, the Novo GT Box features an ergonomic and compact design, available in a variety of striking colours. Whether you’re a beginner or experienced vaper, the Smok Novo GT Box delivers on all fronts, providing versatility, convenience, and excellent performance. Check out our vape fluid and pair it seamlessly with this kit. We Recommend useing 50/50 or Nic Salts E-Liquid with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
